Zales says 67% of its core shoppers now buy fine jewellery for themselves, not as a gift.

The Signet banner's new campaign, You Are The Occasion, is built on that number from its own till. Two of its three style stories need no occasion at all, and the imagery now includes men.

A self-purchase rate this high breaks the gift calendar, moves price points down and frequency up, and shortens the sale — buyer and wearer are the same person.

Platinum added 4.56% this morning — the biggest move of any metal on the tape, and the third stale mark this desk has retired in five days.

Kitco's 05:59 New York board: gold $4,581.60, silver $69.31, platinum $1,881.00, palladium $1,336.00, cross-checked on TradingEconomics. Platinum and palladium's week-old holds are both retired, coming off below the live range this time instead of above it.

Gold is the number every desk will print. Platinum is the one that changes what a setting costs to make.
